        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        String str_input = scanner.next();
        int position_of_at = -1;
        for (int idx = 1; idx < str_input.length() - 1; ++idx) {
            if (str_input.charAt(idx) == 'a' && str_input.charAt(idx + 1) == 't' && idx + 1 != str_input.length() - 1) {
                position_of_at = idx;
                break;
            }
        }
        System.out.print(str_input.charAt(0));
        int j = 1;
        while (j < str_input.length()) {
            if (j + 2 < str_input.length() && str_input.charAt(j) == 'd' && str_input.charAt(j + 1) == 'o' && str_input.charAt(j + 2) == 't' && j + 2 != str_input.length() - 1) {
                System.out.print('.');
                j += 3;
                continue;
            }
            if (j == position_of_at) {
                System.out.print('@');
                j += 2;
                continue;
            }
            System.out.print(str_input.charAt(j));
            j++;
        }
        scanner.close();
    }
}
